entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about a jersey I bought a little while back. I finally got around to trying it on for a ride and it's definitely the wrong size.
I see. I can certainly try to help with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it's a preference, I guess. It's just far too tight in the shoulders. I'd like to see about an exchange for a larger size or just a return.
Understood. Sizing can be tricky. Do you have your order number handy so I can look up the purchase details?
Yes, let me pull it up. It's VF-7821-4550.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the jersey was delivered to you 83 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy for apparel items.
Right, it's been a while. I was saving it for the new season.
No problem at all. Okay, I've confirmed it. That jersey falls under our standard 10-day return policy, so you're still within the window. I can absolutely process a return for you for a full refund.

That's great news, I appreciate you checking. Now, since I am going to be buying the correct size from you anyway, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order? To make the exchange a little smoother.

I understand the request, but our system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for a return based on sizing. However, I can send the return instructions and shipping label to your email on file right now so you can get your refund processed as quickly as possible.
I see. Okay, is the return shipping at least covered then?
Per our standard return policy, the cost of the return shipping is deducted from the refund amount. The email I'm sending will have all the details and the exact amount.
Alright, well, I had to ask. It's good that I can return it at all. Please send over that email.
Of course. I've just sent it now. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
